Definition: from G1909 and G4987; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek additionally:--heap.
BiblicalUsage: Episoreuo means to heap up, to accumulate teachers — and Paul warns that the time will come when men will not endure sound doctrine, but after their own lusts shall they heap to themselves teachers, having itching ears.
TheologicalSignificance: Not one teacher too many, but teachers chosen to say what we already want to hear: heaping teachers is the mark of itching ears.
